sloka: अथ काले गते तस्मिन् षष्ठे अहनि तदा आगते ।सौमित्रम् अब्रवीद् रामो यत्तो भव समाहितः ॥१-३०-७॥
transliteration: atha kāle gate tasmin ṣaṣṭhe ahani tadā āgate ।saumitram abravīd rāmo yatto bhava samāhitaḥ ॥1-30-7॥

translations.english: Time passed. When the sixth day arrived Rama cautioned Lakshmana to be vigilant.
